name: xialingguo-ip
title_zh: 先问清标题和姿势，再出真人 IP 封面的设计 Ski
tagline_zh: 封面做出来不像自己，是多数人卡住的地方。它先一问一答收齐标题、风格、视觉重点、真人姿势和素材，再动手出图。
tagline_en: Most covers don't look like you. This one interviews you first — title, style, focal point, pose, assets — then.
desc_en: 夏林果真人 IP 封面设计 Skill；调用后先通过一问一答收集标题、风格、视觉重点、真人姿势和素材，再为 AI、Web 出海与效率类内容生成封面。
why_zh: 它把「问」放在「画」前面：姿势和视觉重点由你定，不是模型替你猜。素材缺哪块它会当场要，不硬编。
why_en: It asks before it draws: pose and focal point come from you, not the model's guess. Missing assets get requested on the spot.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 AI、Web 出海、效率三类内容的封面，别的题材它不接；必须先答完那轮问答，跳过就直接停。
limit_en: Only covers AI, Web-going-global and productivity content; other topics are refused. You must finish the Q&A round first. Your real pose and assets.
title_en: Real-person IP cover designer that interviews you first
